shared_elements: rectangular field of carved script-like blocks arranged in rows/columns
flat upright carved stone panel/monolith surface
possible column of glyph blocks along one edge of the upright slab
justification: Both surfaces appear to carry rectangular script-like blocks set out in orderly rows/columns, and the upright slab in B seems to bear such a glyph column beside a figural area, which is a reasonably specific correspondence with A's dense all-over glyph grid. The decisive difference is that A is entirely a text field with no figures or scenic composition, whereas B's carved face is dominated by a standing figural image with only subsidiary text, and most of B's frame is architecture rather than decorated surface.
